field.label: Enable MCP Server
field.comment: While disabled, the MCP endpoint refuses every message.

field.label: Read-only Mode
field.comment: Clients may only call abilities that read data; every ability that writes or deletes is blocked.

field.label: Expose Anonymous Abilities
field.comment: Abilities that any guest may call through the REST API, such as account creation or guest checkout. Through MCP the CAPTCHA and rate limits set for each REST route do not apply, so these abilities stay denied unless this is Yes. Yes also lets every GraphQL ability run, since they all run as a guest; set Enable GraphQL Abilities to No to keep them off.

group.label: Personal Data
group.comment: An MCP client hands every result it receives to its AI provider. While personal data is hidden, the values below reach the client as "[personal data]", and a log that records the calls keeps them the same way. To show personal data to particular abilities, select them on Stores › MCP Server and choose Show personal data.

field.label: Hide Personal Data
field.comment: No sends the personal data in every result to clients as it is. Make sure a data processing agreement with the AI provider covers it.

field.label: Personal Data Fields
field.comment: One field name per line; * stands for any characters. Case, underscores and other signs are ignored, so customer_firstname, customerFirstname and firstname all match *firstname. Every value under a matching field is hidden, however deep it sits, and so is the value of a custom attribute whose code matches.

field.label: Enable GraphQL Abilities
field.comment: Offer every GraphQL query field as an ability, run as a guest through the store's own /graphql endpoint; they stay denied until Expose Anonymous Abilities is Yes.

field.label: Expose GraphQL Mutations
field.comment: Also offer every GraphQL mutation field as an ability; mutations write data, so read-only mode blocks them.

field.label: GraphQL Endpoint URL
field.comment: An absolute http(s) URL ending in /graphql, for a server that cannot reach its public host name; empty means the store view's secure base URL followed by graphql.

field.label: Store View
field.comment: The store view GraphQL abilities run in, sent as the Store header; empty means the default store view.
